name: Juan Atkins
hook: Heard Kraftwerk on Detroit radio next to Parliament and built techno out of the gap between them.
blurb: Atkins grew up in Detroit as the car industry collapsed, listening to a radio DJ called the Electrifying Mojo who played Kraftwerk, Parliament and Prince in the same hour, at a time when most radio kept Black and white music apart. With Rick Davis he made 'Clear' in 1983, then founded Metroplex and named what he was doing techno. He is the point where European electronic music and Black American funk fully merge into something new, and the city's history is part of why. Detroit's lost industry, white families moving out to the suburbs, and the cheap rent and cheap secondhand gear left behind are part of the story. It is machine music made by someone watching machines put his city out of work.
